title: Your savings are melting
hook_variants: Ten thousand dollars in a drawer is losing money right now.
Doing nothing with your money is a decision. A costly one.
Your savings account has a leak.

scenes.say: Ten thousand dollars sitting still is losing money. Right now.
The number stays the same. What it buys does not.
At three percent inflation, here is what your ten thousand really buys.
After ten years, you've quietly lost about twenty-six hundred dollars.
scenes.label: BUYING POWER LOST

scenes.say: So beat it. Higher interest savings. Index funds. Skills that raise your pay.
Cash is safe from crashes. It is not safe from time.
Follow Landed Costs. Not financial advice, just math.

caption:
At 3% inflation, $10,000 buys only ~$7,441 worth of stuff after 10 years. Cash is safe from crashes, not from time. ⏳

Not financial advice, just math.
